study: prompt-57 independent entry-strategy research (offline only, live Simulator untouched)

data.source: data.binance.vision USD-M futures 1m klines + 1m mark-price klines + funding + 5m metrics (open interest); fapi fundingRate for Nov; binance.com public leverage brackets; spot 5m klines only to replay the live OB+VP indicator

periods.validation_batches: calendar weeks (7 days) inside validation and out-of-sample; each must hold >= 20 completed trades
periods.walk_forward: train 28 days, test next 14 days, step 14 days, re-select parameters per family on each train window

trading.target: +25% NET of margin after taker fees (0.05% per side) and slippage (0.02% per side)
trading.entry_fill: open of the 1m bar that starts 1 minute after the 5m signal close, plus slippage (60 s latency, never the signal close)
trading.exit_fill: target trigger on last-price 1m high/low; emergency trigger on mark-price 1m extremes; same-minute ties resolved against the trade
trading.funding: actual 8h funding on mark notional while open
trading.margin_mode: cross; account liquidation when equity on worst 1m mark <= sum of tier-1 maintenance margin (Binance public brackets)
trading.emergency_exit_meaning: close a position when its loss incl. costs reaches k x its margin (k=2 -> 10% of the wallet per position); reported separately, never counted as a win

selection_rule.development: per family pick the parameter set with the highest net margin-units per trade under k=2 with >= 175 completed trades on development
selection_rule.validation: family winners ranked by validation net profit; candidate must have >= 20 completed trades in every validation week and positive net
selection_rule.out_of_sample: evaluated once, after selection is frozen in selection-frozen.json; no further tuning
selection_rule.baseline: costed coin-flip: random side at random 5m closes, same trade-count, same exits, 200 seeds

pass_criteria: >= 20 completed trades in every validation and out-of-sample week
positive net profit after all costs in validation AND out-of-sample
net per trade above the 95th percentile of the costed coin-flip baseline in out-of-sample
no account liquidations; emergency exits reported
profitable on at least 7 of 12 coins in out-of-sample and no single coin providing more than 50% of net profit
walk-forward: positive net in at least 4 of the test folds
